case_title: ROLANDO GONZALEZ VS. COGHLAN LAW OFFICES

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $12,500.00 FILED BY GONZALEZ, ROLANDO AS TO DEFENDANT COGHLAN LAW OFFICES ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-26-2025 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF GONZALEZ, ROLANDO AS TO DEFENDANT COGHLAN LAW OFFICES
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED APR-29-2025, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT COGHLAN LAW OFFICES

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-26-2025 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-26-2025 BY VISITING JUDGE CINDEE MAYFIELD. APPEARANCES: PLAINTIFF ROLANDO GONZALEZ IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT COGHLAN LAW OFFICES (OMAR NAKIB) IS PRESENT. CLERK: M. DE LUNA. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. NOT REPORTED (D506)
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) OMAR NAKIB FILED BY DEFENDANT COGHLAN LAW OFFICES
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-26-2025 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GONZALEZ, ROLANDO IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT COGHLAN LAW OFFICES DEFENDANT ENTERED INTO WRITTEN CONTRACT TO PROVIDE SPECIFIED LEGAL SERVICES FOR FLAT FEE OF $5000. PLAINTIFF FULLY PERFORMED BY PAYING $5000. DUETO COVID AND DEFENDANT'S LAW OFFICE CHANGING LOCATION, THERE WERE COMMUNICATION LAPSES WHICH DO NOT AMOUNT TO A BREACH OF CONTRACT. DEFENDANT BREACHED CONTRACT IN 2023 WHEN IT DEMANDED ADDITIONAL PAYMENT ($2000). HOWEVER, PLAINTIFF SUSTAINED NO DAMAGES BECAUSE HE DID NOT PAY THE REQUESTED $2000. (SEE THE REST OF THE JUDGMENT ON THE REGISTER OF ACTION). STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
